about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packages can not be activated on the same account twice!

Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This pack includes:

  • Unique rank 16 tackler fighter “Amber”

  • Unique weapon “Amber A15”

  • Active module “Drop” active defence

  • Unique portrait “Dobrynya, son of Vseslav”

Additionally, the pilot receives:

  • 10% bonus to credits gain for 90 days

  • Unique pattern “Kittens uprising”

  • Unique animated decor “K9”

Additionally, the pilot receives the modules:

  • Unique shield modifier “Defence systems configurator”

  • Unique CPU modifier “Chance” computing adapter

  • Active module “Target Painter”

  • Active module “Shield Booster M”

  • Active module “Engine Suppressor”

  • Engine modifier “Inertial Stabilizer”

  • Capacitor modifier “Emergency Barrier”

  • Shield modifier “Auxiliary Shield Projector”

  • Shield modifier “Energy Recuperation System”

  • Hull modifier “Reinforced Beams”

  • CPU modifier “Horizon” module

  • CPU modifier “Overclocked CPU”

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 90 days!

“Amber” is the Seventh Squadron’s newest multi-purpose tackler fighter, manufactured using technologies of various states. Information about its combat capabilities is currently scarce. The UMC hopes to secure the right for mercenaries to purchase “Amber” units in the near future, as well as obtain the relevant documentation. The UMC’s relentless pursuit of the “Amber” shows that the ship, capable of causing its enemies to freeze, is worth the effort and may be nicknamed after precious fossilized resin for a reason.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz, Intel Core 2 Duo / 2.5 GHz, AMD A6-9220
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Video Card: 512 MB, NVidia / AMD Radeon / Intel (HD 3000, HD 4000) with support for Pixel Shader 3.0 (AMD Radeon X1000 not supported)
  • Hard Disk Space: 8.5 GB
  • Additional: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz, Intel Core 2 Duo / 2.5 GHz, AMD A6-9220
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Video Card: 1024 MB, NVidia GeForce 650 / AMD Radeon HD 5750
  • Hard Disk Space: 8.5 GB
  • Additional: Broadband Internet connection
